_help: days    : '3-6' range | '1,3,5' list | '2-8/2' every other | '4' one day
times   : M=Morning A=Afternoon E=Evening N=Night. Combine: 'M,A' or 'M,A,E,N'
move    : bare pattern name, or {pattern, speed, distance, axis, radius}
requires: 'beaten: NAME' | 'met: NAME' | 'flag: NAME', any prefixed with 'not '.
Compound gates use the longhand object form.
when    : optional rule list, evaluated TOP TO BOTTOM, FIRST MATCH WINS.
A rule states when the character is present plus ONLY what differs.
Anything a rule omits falls back to the character's own value above.
loop    : set false for story characters who must never repeat when the
calendar loops -- they are matched against the real day instead.
CALENDAR mirrors Celeste Harbour's (opens day 1, authored through 8, loops days
5-8 for ever) so this building's cast cycles in step with the town outside.
The three Card Elders stand behind the three card mats (CardMat/2/3 in TownHall.tscn).
Day 3 they are gift-giving NPCs (kind: npc) because the queue is too long; days 4-6
and 8 they battle. The Plaza Challengers are their challengers and spectators, days 3-8.
All of them moved here from the Celeste Harbour plaza with their schedules unchanged.

says.rematch_win: Come back any time and battle us old folk.
says.loss: Don't be disheartened, the rain will always stop.

says.meet: Hoh Hoh, are you looking to enter the Gym Hero Challenge? If you beat all 3 of us Elders we will grant you permission! .....However I'm already flat out with all these tourists. Take this card for now and come back tomorrow instead when it's quieter

says.meet: Are you ready to take me on then? If you win then you'll do well in the Gym Hero Challenge.

says.first_win: Well well well, what a jolly good play! You've earned this.
says.rematch_win: We've been winning and losing for so long it's always fun either way.
says.loss: When you fail, get up and try again.

says.meet: Hold on there sonny boy, with the SS Anne, you've arrived a bit too late! There's a lot of people already in the queue, by the looks of things it'll take us all day to get through this lot but it should be quieter tomorrow so take this card to help with your patience.
says.repeat: Make sure you've earned as many cards as you can around here, you'll need them to defeat us 3.
